description: Named the fifth bar, gave his hand once, and refused to rescue it at two.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Came early, then counted four bars in his fist and came on the fifth.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Called from the shop, named the copy dishonest, and asked for Sunday and the book.
name: Richard Field

description: Waited with the sword, and refused to count the bars for Cowley.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Read the plot and played the bill.
name: William Shakespeare
